context: Tests whether the tidy skill dispatches three parallel audit agents, classifies findings by severity, writes a tidy report with fixes applied, applies one fix per commit with tidy: prefix, avoids code file changes, and uses AskUserQuestion for finding selection.

checklist.name: Parallel agents
checklist.description: Three parallel Explore agents are dispatched in a single message with run_in_background

checklist.name: Severity classification
checklist.description: Findings are classified by severity: must-fix, should-fix, or nice-to-have

checklist.name: One fix per commit
checklist.description: Each documentation fix gets its own git commit with a message starting with tidy:. A 'Fixes Applied' table in the tidy report is also accepted as evidence.

checklist.name: Tidy report written
checklist.description: A tidy report is written to docs/plans/ with a 'Fixes Applied' section documenting each fix and its commit message

checklist.name: No code changes
checklist.description: Only documentation files are modified, not source code files

checklist.name: User selection
checklist.description: AskUserQuestion is used to let the user choose which findings to address
